title: Pretty Face
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a bus crash leaves teenage karate star Rando burned and comatose, a plastic surgeon rebuilds his face from the photo in his pocket: the girl he likes, Rina. Mistaken for Rina's long-lost twin sister, he lives with her family as a girl while hiding his identity. A cross-dressing shounen comedy, cancelled after six volumes (MU).
life_message: Who you are inside matters more than the face others see.
